critical_code_review_comments: All 35 DOH Analysis test cases PASS
DOH formula correctly implements: DOH = Inventory / Daily ROS
Weighted average DOH formula: Sum(DOH x Inv) / Sum(Inv)
Classification uses ±20% of ideal DOH (default 9d = 7.2-10.8d optimal range)
include_wh=true adds warehouse stock to DOH calculation (7.4d -> 38.9d)
Topseller detection uses top 20% revenue with multiplier (default 2x) for effective_ideal_doh
Category-specific ideal DOH CRUD works via /api/analytics/doh/category-ideal
Heatmap supports store and category views with color-coded status
Correlation endpoint calculates Pearson coefficient between DOH and stock-outs
Recommendations sorted by priority (critical > high > medium > low)
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 4 tabs and controls verified working
